links.outcome: LLM accuracy on text vs image-based nursing licensing exam questions
links.effect: Text accuracy 92.1-94.6% across models; image-based accuracy fell to 48% (Doubao, ERNIE) and 61% (iFLYTEK Spark); text vs image difference significant (p<0.01). Authors say findings do not support clinical applicability.
links.quote: However, their performance on image-based items is substantially lower, and the findings do not support claims of clinical applicability.

screen.reason: The study is an automated benchmark evaluating multiple LLMs and multimodal foundation models on questions from the Chinese National Nursing Licensing Examination.
